title: OpenAI says its models found up to 14% more headroom in AMD's flagship GPU designs
summary: OpenAI reported on Wednesday that its models rewrote the SystemVerilog descriptions of AMD circuits to lift power, performance and area by as much as 14% against baselines the chipmaker's engineers had already tuned, work it calls roughly a year of progress in under five months. AMD has put some model-written edits into a design sent for manufacturing and verified single-digit gains on blocks of a next-generation CPU. On OpenAI's own Jalapeño inference chip, standard-cell area fell about 13% in the vector unit.
